scientific_integrity: An infinite-to-finite reduction, exact 2-adic state weights and a standalone 960-case certificate establish the stated classification. The prior longest-palindrome cutoff is credited. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns the binary regular paperfolding instruction sequence, its ordinary contiguous palindromes, and natural starting-position densities. It does not treat other folding instructions or all factor frequencies. The 64-state enumeration is exhaustively justified by a congruence lemma and reproducible checker; supplementary prefix checks are not an infinite proof. A potentially unindexed equivalent result is a residual literature risk.
title: Uniform palindrome occurrence densities in the regular paperfolding word
